title: Drupal core change records preserve introduced branch and version
summary: Drupal core change records are the official record of the release branch and release version in which a change occurred.

sources.locator: official record of the release branch and release version
sources.title: Change records

drupal_core.notes: Each derived change record must carry its own introduced branch/version values.

actions: Represent introduced branch and introduced version when modeling Drupal core changes.
checks: Fail validation for Drupal change-derived records that omit version applicability.
automation_hints: Upgrade analysis should compare project Drupal core version with introduced/deprecated/removed constraints.

enforcement.rationale: Version provenance is required for correct matching; individual reviewed records decide enforcement.
